verses.1: Mashkil for David when he was in the cave of Tefila.
verses.2: My voice cries out to the LORD! My voice pleads with the LORD!
verses.3: I will pour out my troubles before him; I will speak of my sorrows before him.
verses.4: As my spirit is enveloped in darkness, you will know where I am. You will know the path I take in this place. Now go ahead, and fill me with sorrow.
verses.5: Look to the right, and see that I have no one to know. Manos has gone away from me; there is no one who seeks my soul anymore.
verses.6: I cried out to you, O LORD! I said, “You are my protector; you give me a place to live in this land of life.”
verses.7: Listen to my cries, for I am in great distress. Save me from my pursuers, for they have come after me.
verses.8: I will bring my soul out of its prison, so that I may praise your name. The righteous will be sealed with you, for you will take pity on me.
